tei:div.tei:p: kun thub sgrib shing zhwa srung zhang khrom gter byon phyag len ma bzhugs: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: sngags pa nang rgyas byung ba dang: sde brgyad gza' srin ki kang dang: ma mo mkha' 'gro rgyu phyogs su: thams cad kun thub sgrib shing bstan: sa ma ya: zhes pa sngags 'di rnams shing tsher ma can gyi shing la bris nas zhwa la gdags so: shing bu gru gsum: sen gang ma yin: zab mi zab lag tu blangs pas shes: rab gnas rten 'brel snying pos byed: dar dmar gyis dril la tshon skud sna lngas bcing: zlog pa'am drag las byed dus zhwa nag la 'dog: sa ma ya: 'di 'dra'i sgrib shing 'jig rten dkon: ma byung mi 'byung 'byung mi 'gyur: zhes so: kha thaṃ: 'di kho na'o:1$0000270 rgya zhang khrom gyi gter ma'o// rang gi bu la ster kyang gser srang re tsam gyi maṇḍal med par byin gyur na/ srung ma khros te 'khu ldog sna tshogs 'byung*/ gshin rje king kang rlung sgrub kyi las mtha' sgrib shing*/ nag po shin tu zab pa rig sngags 'chang ba chen po mthu stobs dbang phyug dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i sdes kyang yid brtan du mdzad pa'i u pa de sha'o// shu bhaṃ/// /
